workflow.acquisition.fetchMagnet.handler: Downloads through the configured aria2 RPC endpoint, then continues when the files are complete.
Opens the magnet with the server’s default application. This step does not track the external client; follow it with a node that waits for files in the pending processing folder.
Only if aria2 was started with --rpc-secret.
workflow.acquisition.fetchMagnet.timeout: Stops this download if it has not completed within this time.

workflow.diagnostics.title: Configuration check
workflow.diagnostics.failed: The check could not finish. Retry; the current result is unknown.
workflow.diagnostics.unchecked: The current configuration has not been checked.
workflow.diagnostics.limit: Checks node configuration and the server environment. It does not verify links or guarantee successful execution.
workflow.acquisition.fetchMagnet.handler: Downloads on the server and stops seeding when complete. Speed and availability depend on peers and connectivity.
workflow.activity.acquisition.resolveSha: Reads accessible sharing pages or full shared text and uses the configured AI to extract links and passwords. Login-protected or dynamic pages may be unavailable. This node does not download files.
workflow.activity.acquisition.selectLink: Selects a parsed download link using the configured preference order. It does not search drives by resource name or download files.
Downloads HTTP(S) files on the server with configurable connections, retries, speed limits and a timeout. Resumes only when saved progress and the server’s file version can be verified; otherwise restarts. The URL must return the file directly.
workflow.activity.acquisition.waitForInb: Waits for downloaded files to arrive in the server’s pending processing folder, then passes them to the next node. This node does not download files.
workflow.activity.acquisition.fetchMagne: Processes a magnet using the selected download implementation. The built-in engine and aria2 can wait for completion; the system-default client requires a later node to receive its files.
workflow.activity.acquisition.fetchTorre: Reads an uploaded .torrent file or the supplied HTTP(S) torrent URL and downloads on the server with the built-in BitTorrent engine. Preserves the content’s folder structure and stops seeding when complete.
workflow.activity.acquisition.fetchFromP: Obtains or installs the resource through its linked platform account, then passes the platform’s directory to the next node. Requires the relevant account, permissions and server environment.
workflow.activity.acquisition.unpack.des: Inspects obtained files and extracts archives as configured, trying known passwords. It does not obtain missing files.
workflow.activity.acquisition.pickLocalD: Selects an existing folder accessible to the server for subsequent processing. A path on the browser’s computer may not be accessible to the server.
workflow.activity.acquisition.place.desc: Organizes files using the library folder and path template, then passes the resulting directory to the next node.
workflow.activity.acquisition.materializ: Associates the resulting directory with the resource, giving its placeholder record local files. This node does not download or move files.

workflow.validation.acquisition.aiDisabl: The AI feature required to parse shared content is disabled.

workflow.validation.acquisition.invalidS: The acquisition source does not meet this node’s requirements. Check the input type and value.
workflow.validation.acquisition.timeoutI: The download timeout must be between 1 and 43200 minutes.
workflow.validation.acquisition.aria2Rpc: aria2 needs an HTTP(S) RPC URL and a poll interval between 1 and 60 seconds.
workflow.validation.acquisition.magnetIn: Enter a magnet link with a valid BitTorrent info hash.
workflow.validation.acquisition.httpSour: Enter an HTTP(S) URL for the file itself.

workflow.validation.acquisition.systemHa: The system client opens on the server. Add a node that waits for files in the pending processing folder to receive the download.
workflow.validation.unknownTrigger: This trigger is unavailable. Choose an installed, supported trigger.
workflow.validation.invalidTriggerConfig: The trigger configuration is invalid. Check its filters and required fields.
workflow.validation.unknownActivity: This node is not installed or is unavailable. Replace it or restore its implementation.
workflow.validation.invalidContract: The node has an invalid input or output declaration. Check its implementation.
workflow.validation.typeMismatch: This node cannot accept the preceding output type. Adjust the node order or conversion.
workflow.validation.destructiveAfterAdap: Automatically adapted data cannot directly drive destructive operations such as deleting or moving files. Check the input and adjust the conversion.
workflow.validation.missingOutputType: This node needs an explicit output type. Set its target type in the configuration.
workflow.validation.invalidJson: The node configuration is not valid JSON. Correct its contents.
workflow.validation.validationFailed: The check could not finish. Review the node configuration and retry.
workflow.editor.builtinCopyHint: Save edits as a new workflow while keeping the built-in workflow and its existing tasks unchanged.
workflow.acquisition.fetchHttp.parallelC: Maximum simultaneous connections; 1 uses a single connection.
workflow.acquisition.fetchHttp.maxRetrie: Retry transient network failures; 0 disables retries.
workflow.acquisition.fetchHttp.speedLimi: Total speed limit for this download; 0 means unlimited.
workflow.acquisition.fetchHttp.timeoutMi: Maximum time for this download, including retries.
workflow.acquisition.fetchHttp.automatic: Chunking is automatic when the server supports Range requests and its file version can be verified. Resume also needs a valid saved checkpoint. Otherwise, downloads use one connection or restart.
workflow.validation.acquisition.httpConn: Parallel connections must be an integer between 1 and 16.
workflow.validation.acquisition.httpRetr: The retry count must be an integer between 0 and 10.
workflow.validation.acquisition.httpSpee: The speed limit must be an integer between 0 and 1048576 KiB/s; 0 means unlimited.
